title: Made By Ajdar TPTool GUI
features:
🚀 TPTool Script – Features (Made by Ajdar)
- 🧭 Click-to-Teleport Tool
Instantly teleport to the location you click with your mouse.
- 🎒 Custom Tool Injection
Automatically adds a “TPTool” to your inventory when the script runs.
- 🖱️ Manual Activation
Teleportation only happens when the tool is equipped and clicked — no accidental teleports.
- 💡 Safe Positioning
Teleports you slightly above the ground to avoid getting stuck.
- 🌈 Neon GUI Interface
Stylish neon-themed GUI with smooth rounded corners and a modern look.
- 🔘 One-Click Tool Access
Just click the “Get TPTool” button to receive the tool instantly.
- 🔒 Filtering Enabled Compatible
Works safely on games with FE enabled — affects only your character.
- 🧠 Executor Friendly
Compatible with popular executors like Synapse X, Fluxus, Hydrogen, and more.

changelog.message: Add TPTool Gui With Teleport Functionally
